opening.argument: The video presents a countdown of ways to earn money through gaming, while cautioning viewers against quitting their regular jobs to try them. Its discussion of selling in-game assets explicitly warns that scams are common and that many games prohibit the practice. Livestreaming is described as a content-creation route, not a guaranteed return. Nothing in the statement describes a request to send money, provide credentials, or join a scheme. The Hi-Rez Studios sponsorship appears as ordinary sponsorship context, with no described connection to asset trading or a deceptive payment flow. These are informational examples with stated limitations, not a solicitation.

citations.quote: we're counting down the top 10 ways you can earn money playing video games
we do not recommend quitting your day job right away to try these tips
Just be careful, scams abound and many games forbid this practice, so know the rules before you buy or sell anything.
If you'd like to make money outside of working in the industry look into being a live streamer or a YouTuber, creating your own content
sponsors can support you either with merchandise or cash usually in exchange for showing off their products
